what_this_is: The written list of verifier differences that are EXPLAINED for the public charity and donor-advised fund sponsor load (scripts/verify-public-charities.ts). Same rules as lib/funder-reference/verify-exceptions.json: a difference is explained only if one entry below matches its line exactly as the checker prints it after the word MISMATCH; every other difference is unexplained and marks the state NOT VERIFIED. The list starts empty: no difference is known to be harmless until someone has found its cause and written it down here.

fields.cause: In plain words, why the difference happens and why it does not mean a stored value is wrong.
fields.pattern: A regular expression (JavaScript syntax, as a JSON string) tested against ONE mismatch line. It must name what it explains; a pattern that matches an empty line, or unrelated lines, is refused when the command starts.
fields.evidence: Where the cause was established: the EIN and object id of an example, the filing element, the report or ruling.
fields.date: The date the entry was written, YYYY-MM-DD.

how_to_add: Find the cause first. Then add one object with all five fields to the list below and commit the file. Never add an entry to make a run pass without a cause.
